claim: Kobarid Museum opens year-round with seasonal hours (Jan-Mar/Oct-Dec 10:00-17:00; Apr-Jun/Sep 9:00-18:00; Jul-Aug 9:00-19:00); adults €8, pensioners/students €6, schoolchildren €4, family €20; materials in Slovene, English, German, Italian.
quote: Adults: EUR 8 ... Pensioners/Students: EUR 6 ... Schoolchildren: EUR 4 ... Family ticket: EUR 20 ... January-March and October-December: 10:00-17:00; April-June and September: 9:00-18:00; July-August: 9:00-19:00

claim: The Italian Charnel House above Kobarid (built 1936-38, opened by Mussolini) holds the remains of 7,014 Italian soldiers from the Isonzo battles in an octagonal structure designed by Giannino Castiglioni next to the Church of St Anthony.
quote: The Italian Charnel House, Kobarid is an Italian military shrine ... It houses the remains of 7,014 Italians who fell during the battles of the Isonzo ... built in the shape of an octagon ... formed by sculptor Giannino Castiglioni

claim: The Charnel House is reached by a 15-20 minute walk on a paved switchback road from Kobarid centre (or by car to a small lot); admission free during daylight, allow 30-45 minutes, no toilets/cafe on site.
quote: From Kobarid's centre, it's a 15-20-minute walk up a paved switchback road ... Admission is free and the grounds are accessible during daylight hours ... Allow 30-45 minutes for a visit

claim: The Walk of Peace Visitor Centre in Kobarid (Gregorčičeva 8) offers a free interactive exhibition, maps and guidebooks; open weekdays year-round with extended summer hours (Jul-Aug Mon-Fri 9:00-19:00), in English, Italian and Slovenian.
quote: Winter (Nov 1-Mar 31): Mon-Fri 9:00-13:00 & 14:00-16:00 ... July-August: Mon-Fri 9:00-19:00 ... free access to its 'interactive exhibition' ... Available in English, Italian, and Slovenian

claim: Kluže Fortress near Bovec opens Mar 3-Apr 6 daily 10:00-17:00, weekends only in April-May, daily 10:00-16:00 Jun-Sep; adults €5, students/pensioners €3, family €12; themes span 15th-century anti-Ottoman defence, Napoleonic resistance and WWI Isonzo Front.
quote: March 3-April 6: Daily 10:00-17:00 ... June-September: Daily 10:00-16:00 ... Adults €5.00 ... defense against Turkish invasions ... Napoleon's army ... World War I's Isonzo Front

claim: Fort Hermann, built 1897-1900 above Kluže to support it during Austria-Hungary, is reached by a 30-minute marked hike that includes a lit 100 m stone tunnel.
quote: built as a support to the Kluže Fort, between years 1897 and 1900 ... A 30-minute marked hiking route with an illuminated 100-meter stone tunnel connects it to the main fortress

claim: Kolovrat Outdoor Museum is a free, open-24/7 cross-border ridge-top site preserving Italy's third line of defence on the Isonzo Front with trenches, caverns and a spiral-staircase cave; a guided tour lasts 1.5 hours and panoramas reach to the Adriatic.
quote: preserved command posts, shooting positions, a network of trenches and caves featuring notable 'spiral stairs in one of them' ... The guided tour lasts 1.5 hours ... panoramic vistas of the Soča Valley, Julian Alps, and Adriatic Sea

claim: Javorca Memorial Church of the Holy Spirit near Tolmin (Austro-Hungarian wooden memorial, 1916) opens Apr 4-May 31 weekends 10:00-17:00, daily 10:00-19:00 Jun 1-Aug 24, and 10:00-16:00 Aug 31-Nov 11; closed in bad weather and winter except by reservation.
quote: April 4 - May 31: Weekends/holidays 10:00-17:00 ... June 1 - August 24: Daily 10:00-19:00 ... August 31 - November 11: Daily 10:00-16:00 (weather dependent) ... In case of bad weather, the church is closed

claim: Javorca tickets cost €5 adult, €4 student/senior, €2.50 child; price includes a short guided tour in Slovene or English; Julian Alps card holders enter free, and a combined Javorca + Tolmin Gorges ticket costs €10.50-€14.50 by season.
quote: Adults: €5.00 ... Students (up to 26) & Seniors (65+): €4.00 ... Children (6-15 years): €2.50 ... Julian Alps card holders: Free ... Combined Ticket (Javorca + Tolmin Gorges) ... March, April, May, October, November: €10.50 ... June, July, August, September: €14.50

claim: Tolmin Museum (Mestni trg 4) opens Tue-Fri 9:00-16:00 and weekends 13:00-17:00 (Jul-Aug Tue-Fri 10:00-18:00, weekends 14:00-18:00), closed Mondays; adults €5, children/students/seniors €4, free on 8 Feb, 18 May and 3 Dec.
quote: Tuesday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., Saturday, Sunday and Holidays from 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. Closed on Monday ... 5 € for adults, 4 € for children, students and seniors ... Free entrance is offered on February 8, May 18, and December 3

claim: Most na Soči (15 km south of Kobarid) is one of Europe's most prominent prehistoric sites with an Early Iron Age cemetery of over 6,000 burials; the Archaeological Museum is housed in the village's elementary school and run by Tolmin Museum.
quote: Most na Soči ranks among the most prominent prehistoric sites in Europe ... extensive cemetery from the Early Iron Age ... revealed over 6000 burials ... The Archaeological museum Most na Soči is located in the elementary school in Most na Soči

claim: Mrzli vrh Outdoor Museum (1,359 m) above Tolmin is the 'bloodiest battlefield of the Isonzo Front', accessed by a 1.5-2 hour walk; trenches, caverns and a 1917 concrete altar built by Hungarian soldiers survive on the ridge.
quote: The steep slope above Tolmin, which is now an outdoor museum, is a synonym for the bloodiest battlefield of the Isonzo Front ... Mrzli vrh (1359 m) was a key point in the Austro-Hungarian defence ... a concrete altar was erected by the Hungarian soldiers in 1917

claim: Mengore hill above Tolmin, fortified with trenches and caves as the core of the Austro-Hungarian Tolmin bridgehead, is reached by a 30-45 minute hike and topped by the 1493 Church of the Name of Mary.
quote: Mengore hill, together with the two neighbouring hills ... was the core of the Austro-Hungarian defence of the Tolmin bridgehead ... hike to Mengore will take you about 30 to 45 minutes ... Church of the Name of Mary from 1493
